task.title: Fix TypeScript SDK write-attempt read-cache invalidation

events.content: Bracket cache-aware file mutations with pre-request and finally eviction: Bracket cache-aware file mutations with pre-request and finally eviction

raw.question: Bracket cache-aware file mutations with pre-request and finally eviction
raw.chosen: Bracket cache-aware file mutations with pre-request and finally eviction
raw.reasoning: A write attempt invalidates revision knowledge regardless of outcome. Pre-eviction prevents cached hits once the attempt starts; finally eviction removes entries or in-flight reads repopulated during the concurrent-reader window. This favors correctness over retaining a possibly valid entry after auth or network failures.

retrospective.summary: Bracketed SDK file mutations with pre-request and finally cache eviction; added populated-cache 409 and sibling mutation regressions; SDK build, typecheck, and 277 tests pass; success-only source ablation fails all 5 targeted regressions.
